sources.name: BLS Employment Projections (10-year occupational outlook)

sources.attribution: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Projections; national series redistributed by Projections Central.
sources.notes: 10-year projected employment change and average annual openings by detailed occupation (SOC). A projection, not a guarantee; openings include both growth and replacement needs.

sources.name: ACS PUMS empirical field-of-degree → occupation flows
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (1-Year PUMS)
sources.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey Public Use Microdata Sample; occupation mapping via the Census 2018 Occupation Code List.
sources.notes: Empirical share of employed bachelor's-degree holders in each field (FOD1P) by occupation (OCCP->SOC), weighted by PWGTP. Cells from fewer than 10 sampled persons are suppressed; fields under 50 are omitted. An independent check on the modeled CIP->SOC crosswalk, not a replacement for it.
